_note: Fight backgrounds, one per opponent. Key = scene id (art/scenes/<hero>/<id>.webp). 'setting' is the myth-true place; 'palette' follows the opponent's bg colours in the game (bosses have none in the game yet, so theirs are chosen here). build_manifest.py combines these with SCENE_BASE into the 'scenes' section of manifest.json. Optional 'bg': [dark, light] gradient colours for opponents that have none in the game (the bosses); the game uses them on that fight's screen. Entries with a 'screen' key are backgrounds for non-fight screens (draft_start, draft_reward, otg, bossp) instead of an opponent. Campfire, crafting table, altar, map, victory and defeat backgrounds are the UI art in art/game/icons/ui_*.jpg (patch52).

lotus.name: The Lotus-Eaters
lotus.setting: the island of the Lotus-Eaters from Homer's Odyssey at dusk: a drowsy shore of low dunes and tall lotus plants with heavy pale blossoms and honey-coloured fruit, along the left and right edges; a few sleeping sailors slumped among the plants at the far left; a beached Greek ship with its oars abandoned at the far right; thin hazy smoke of poppy incense drifting low; a still, glassy sea and a faint low moon on the horizon
lotus.palette: deep greens from near-black to moss (#0b1a14 to #2f5a3a) with pale cream blossoms and a few honey-gold accents

sirens.name: The Sirens
sirens.setting: the island of the Sirens from Homer's Odyssey: jagged dark sea-rocks rising at the left and right edges, the meadow above them strewn with bleached bones and skulls; winged siren shapes perched as silhouettes on the high rocks at the far right; foaming surf breaking on the rocks; a Greek ship with a bound figure at its mast, tiny and far off on the horizon at the left; a deep night sea under a cold starry sky
sirens.palette: near-black navy to deep sea teal (#07131f to #1f5a78) with bone-white and pale silver accents

polyphemus.name: Polyphemus
polyphemus.setting: inside the cave of the Cyclops Polyphemus on his island, as told in Homer's Odyssey: a huge rough rock cavern; a low hearth fire of embers at the lower left; wicker cheese racks, milk pails and a great olive-wood staff along the left wall; sheep and rams as dark shapes in pens along the right edge; a colossal boulder half-blocking the cave mouth at the right, with a sliver of moonlit sea beyond
polyphemus.palette: near-black browns and deep rust (#1a0b07 to #6b2a14) with ember-orange accents

shades.name: The Shades of Hades

phaeacians.name: The Phaeacians

s_wk_tut_ground.setting: a training terrace on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit from Journey to the West: a stone terrace among misty peaks; wooden posts and straw training dummies along the left edge; racks of staffs, spears and banners along the right edge; peach trees in pink blossom, a waterfall in the distance; a small shrine with incense
s_wk_tut_ground.palette: jade green and peach pink (#0a1a14 to #4f8a6a) with cinnabar banners, gold and misty white

s_wk_draft_start.name: Draft (start of run)
s_wk_draft_start.setting: the great west gate of the Tang capital Chang'an at dawn as the pilgrims set out for the West: the tall red gate tower with its tiled roofs along the left edge; banners, a farewell crowd and officials in silk robes; the white horse loaded with bundles and a monk's staff; the long road winding away west through misty hills on the right The brush rhythm of Chinese ink-wash painting mixed into the pen-and-ink style. s_wk_draft_reward.name: Draft (reward)
s_wk_draft_reward.setting: treasures won from the demons laid out in a cave hall by lantern light: magic gourds, golden bells, a purple-gold calabash, a jade belt, pearls, silk banners and demon weapons heaped on a red carpet before a carved stone throne at the far left; lanterns and stalactites along the right edge The brush rhythm of Chinese ink-wash painting mixed into the pen-and-ink style. s_wk_otg.name: One True God altar
s_wk_otg.setting: a vast ancient sacrificial altar of carved white jade on a mountain peak above the five-coloured clouds of heaven at night: four great bronze tripod cauldrons burning at the corners along the left and right edges; a monumental stair rising from the lower corners; the Milky Way and the moon above; dragons carved on the balustrades The brush rhythm of Chinese ink-wash painting mixed into the pen-and-ink style. Distinctly Chinese: no Japanese, Greek or Norse elements

s_wk_bossp.name: Boss pick
s_wk_bossp.setting: the end of the Western road at the coming of a great storm: on the left the burning Flaming Mountains with the shadow of the Bull Demon King; across the top a storm cloud in the shape of a monkey with six ears; on the right a colossal golden palm of the Buddha rising out of the clouds, five fingers like pillars The brush rhythm of Chinese ink-wash painting mixed into the pen-and-ink style. Distinctly Chinese: no Japanese, Greek or Norse elements
s_wk_bossp.palette: storm violet to ember red (#100814 to #6a2a24) with gold, fire orange and lightning white

robbers.name: The Tomb Robbers
robbers.setting: a looted royal tomb in the Valley of the Kings at night: a torch-lit burial chamber with painted walls of gods in blue, red and gold along the left and right edges; a smashed stone sarcophagus lid at the lower left; spilled gold, jewelled collars and toppled statues across the floor; a rough robbers' tunnel breaking through the far right wall with a rope hanging down; long shadows from the torches Painted with the flat bright colours and bold outlines of Egyptian tomb painting mixed into the pen-and-ink style. scorpions.name: The Scorpions of Serket
scorpions.setting: a desert canyon of red sandstone at dusk, the shrine of the scorpion goddess Serket: a small rock-cut temple with a scorpion carved over the door at the far left; dunes and boulders along the right edge; dozens of scorpions crawling over the rocks in the foreground; a huge orange sun setting over the dunes; tamarisk bushes Painted with the flat bright colours and bold outlines of Egyptian tomb painting mixed into the pen-and-ink style. Distinctly ancient Egyptian: no Greek, Norse or Chinese elements

servants.name: Servants of the Tomb

sobek.name: The Crocodiles of Sobek

anubis.name: The Jackals of Anubis

heka.name: The Priests of Heka

ammit.name: Ammit, the Devourer

s_th_tut_ground.setting: a training court inside an Egyptian temple: a sand floor between painted columns with papyrus capitals; wooden sparring staffs and shields of cowhide on racks along the left edge; archery targets and a scribe's school bench with palettes along the right edge; a sacred ibis by a pool; the temple pylon and palm trees beyond in the morning sun

legion.name: Legion

baal.name: The Prophets of Baal
